questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: Jeg ville gerne til et engelsk talende land med en stærk filosofiafdeling, som også gerne lå uden for Europa. På den måde passede Cornell godt til det jeg ledte efter.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Overordnet set en fed oplevelse. Undervisningen var virkelig god. I bakspejlet ville jeg dog ønske at jeg havde taget afsted i efterårssemesteret, da de sender en meget større flok af udvekslingsstuderende afsted der.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Meget nemt. Det hele blev sendt på mail med klare instruktioner til hvert trin i processen.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Vi havde en enkelt introdag hvor alt det praktiske blev gennemgået. Ellers kunne man finde det meste information på deres hjemmeside og gennem mails. Vi fik tildelt to kontaktpersoner som var ekstremt hjælpsomme til at svare på spørgsmål og give vejledning.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: Universitetet sendte en liste ud med boligselskaber som man kunne kontakte. På forårssemesteret var det relativt nemt at få bolig.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: De fleste udvekslingsstuderende bor off-campus, dog vil jeg anbefale at finde housing i collegetown, da det er der de fleste studerende bosætter sig. Til gengæld kan housing godt være ret dyrt i Ithaca.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Kursusregistreringssystemet var lidt svært at finde rundt i i starten, men da man lige havde fanget hvordan det fungerede var det super nemt. Der var dog mange kurser jeg gerne ville have haft, som de ikke kunne tilbyde, da de faste studerende fik lov at skrive sig op til kurser før de udvekslingsstuderende.

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det hele var digitalt. Man gik bare ind på deres hjemmeside og tilføjede de kurser man gerne ville have. Jeg tog to graduate courses, hvilket krævede at man lige skulle kontakte underviseren på kurset før man kunne blive tilmeldt, men det er for det meste kun nødvendigt hvis man vil have kurser på 6000+ niveau.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kan altid sende dem mails.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Jeg fik nogle af de kurser jeg gerne ville have haft, men med nogle andre var jeg nødt til at nøjes med noget der ikke interesserede mig synderligt meget.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Det er virkelig ikke sikkert at du får de kurser du gerne vil have. Du bliver nødt til at være fleksibel.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Fremragende undervisning

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA classes while you were on exchange *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: Jeg tog et kursus i 2000 puljen, et i 3000 puljen og to i 6000 puljen.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: De fleste af mine kurser var struktureret mere som seminarer fremfor forelæsninger.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer:
Introduction to Bioethics
19th Century Philosophy
Ethics and the Family 
Idealization in Ethics and Epistemology

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your second semester. *
What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Hvis du har mod på det, så vil jeg klart råde dig til at tage et graduate kursus! Emnerne er typisk mere afgrænsede, og man får virkelig mulighed for at dykke dybt ned i emne. Derudover er der meget færre indskrevede på graduate kurserne. På mit ene kursus "Ethics and the Family" var vi omkring 12 indskrevede studerende og to undervisere.

questions.question: Insurance DKK *
Housing DKK per month *
Books DKK per month *
Local transportation DKK per month *
Food DKK per month *
Personal spending DKK per month *
Communication (phone, internet, etc.) DKK per month *
Other fees DKK per month *
What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Priserne på fødevarer er dyrere end man er vandt til i Danmark. Meget er tiden er man nødt til at bruger Uber, i hvert fald hvis man ikke har en bil, hvilket selvfølgelig også koster lidt. Det var generelt end dyrere fornøjelse end jeg havde regnet med, men det er svært at pege på præcis hvad der gjorde det dyrt. Jeg tror bare generelt leveomkostningerne i USA er dyrere end i DK.

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Næsten alt var dyrere.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Jeg brugte ikke rigtig de "non-akademiske muligheder" som Cornell udbød.

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hmmm ved det ikke rigtig, det gjorde jeg ikke rigtig brug af.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Ved ikke

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Tag ud og se landet hvis du har midlerne til det! Tag til New York, Toronto, Niagara Falls, Boston osv.

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var selvfølgelig en smule udfordrende i starten, men altså, så længe man kan snakke engelsk er det fint

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Hmm ved ikke, de er jo lidt anerledes men altså de er jo bare mennesker

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Venligheden, snaksaligheden og åbenheden.

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Bosæt dig i Collegetown. Det bliver dyrere end du tror. Tag til New York så meget du kan.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ikke rigtig

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Det internationale perspektiv og netværk man vender hjem med.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Vinteren. Det er virkelig, virkelig koldt.

questions.question: Any other comments?
questions.answer: Nej

questions.question: Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
